style.toneOfVoiceUnformatted: Step into the Christmas spirit with this HOMCOM artificial tree. No more wrestling with tangled wires—simply plug in this pre-lit tree and watch as 200 warm white LED lights twinkle, making setup easier than ever. Perfect for placing presents under, this tree brings festive cheer to your home throughout the season. It features a removable base to ensure it stands upright all day and night and is adorned with red berries for a burst of color. The 5ft size is ideal for medium-sized rooms and spaces, while the 200 warm white LED lights create a bright and beautiful display with pre-set patterns that can be easily changed. With 518 plastic branches, the tree offers a full and realistic look, and the branches open effortlessly. The detachable and foldable base makes storage easy when the season is over. Assembly is required, but setup is simple. The tree comes in green with warm white lights and is made of PVC and steel. The overall dimensions are 53cm in diameter and 150cm in height, with a 2.7m power cord. It operates on an input of 220-240V/50Hz, with an output of DC 30V/3.6W. Item label: 830-375V71. UK mainland delivery only.
